brand.name: Time Swap
brand.tagline: give an hour, get an hour

metadata.title: Time Swap · give an hour, get an hour
metadata.description: See what people in your city are offering before you sign up. It is paid in hours, not in money.

hero.eyebrow: {city} · time is not stored, it circulates
hero.title: What do you need help with this week?
hero.lead: See what people in {city} are offering before you decide to sign up. It is paid in hours, not in money.

howItWorks.title: This is not paid with money.

oneHourOneCredit.description: Every hour you give someone becomes a credit. The skill you bring makes no difference.

debitLimit.description: You can ask for help before giving anything: the account allows up to three hours in the red.

noMoney.description: Credits are neither bought nor sold. Only materials are reimbursed, if there are any.

categories.title: Browse by what you know how to do
categories.intro: The starting categories are still being decided with the community.

dispute.label: The brake
dispute.title: If something goes wrong, the relay stops.
dispute.body: Either side can open a dispute. The hours for that exchange do not move until someone on the team reviews it, and a reversed movement does not disappear: it is offset by another one and both stay on the record.

signUp.title: Writing to someone requires a verified account
signUp.lead: It is the only barrier, and it exists so that nobody receives messages from anonymous profiles.

metadata.title: Sign in · Time Swap
metadata.description: Sign in to pick up where you left off.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.lead: Sign in to pick up where you left off.

form.label: Sign in
form.remember: Keep me signed in on this device

conduct.before: By signing in you accept the community

credentials.title: The email or the password do not match
credentials.body: Check both fields and try again.

tooManyAttempts.title: Too many attempts
tooManyAttempts.body: We have locked access for a while. If you cannot remember the password, ask for a link to change it.

suspended.title: This account is suspended
suspended.body: Someone on the team is reviewing it. We will write to the email you registered with.

unverified.title: You have not verified your email yet
unverified.body: Look for the link we sent you when you registered. Until then you can browse, but not write to anyone.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has expired
sessionExpired.body: Sign in again to pick up where you left off. Your hours and agreements are still there.

panel.title: Someone in your area asked for exactly what you know how to do.
panel.body: Contact requests wait until you answer them. None expires without warning you.

metadata.title: Recover access · Time Swap
metadata.description: Ask for a link to change your password.

recoverAccess.title: Recover access
recoverAccess.lead: This screen is not built yet. When it is, we will send a single-use link to the email you registered with.

metadata.description: Keep what you offer, what you look for and how people see you up to date.

shell.title: Your profile
shell.leadIndex: Five sections. Open one, save and come back.
shell.leadDetail: One section at a time. The ones you need before publishing are marked.
shell.progressUnavailable: We could not load your progress. The sections are still available.

panel.unsavedBody: If you leave now, the changes in this section are lost.
panel.serverErrorBody: Your changes are still here. Try again in a moment.
panel.loadErrorTitle: We could not load this section
panel.loadErrorBody: Nothing was lost. Try again, or open another section.

hint.visitor: Anyone can see it, even without an account.
hint.contact: Once you accept a contact request.

presentation.lead: How people see you in your listings, your profile and the chat.
presentation.displayNameHint: Always public. Not your legal name.

errors.displayNameRequired: Write the name you want people to see.
errors.bioContainsContact: Remove the phone number or the email. Contact details are shared in the chat, when you decide.
errors.bioTooLong: Shorten the presentation: {max} characters at most.

skills.lead: From the catalogue, with search. You need at least one to publish.
skills.offerHint: They come from the catalogue, not typed: that way people find you searching for the same thing. You need at least one to publish.
skills.wantLabel: What you would like help with
skills.wantHint: Optional. It helps people propose swaps.
skills.noMatch: Nothing in the catalogue with that name.
skills.emptyOffer: You have not chosen any yet. You need at least one to publish.

errors.skillsRequired: Choose at least one skill from the catalogue.

availability.lead: Indicative. A reference for listings and agreements, not a calendar.
availability.gridLabel: Tap the cells where you usually have a moment
availability.hint: Indicative. Shown as a reference in your listings and agreements; it books nothing.

zone.lead: Only the district or the neighbourhood. Never the address.
zone.emptyTitle: You have not chosen a zone yet.
zone.emptyBody: We store the centre of your zone, never your address. It powers searches by proximity.
zone.deniedTitle: The browser did not share your location.
zone.deniedBody: No problem: choose your neighbourhood by hand.
zone.unsupportedTitle: This browser cannot approximate your zone.
zone.noMatch: We could not find that neighbourhood.
zone.precisionLegend: What is shown of your zone
zone.precisionHint: The wider it is, the fewer nearby matches you will see. Everyone sees the district.
zone.revealHint: The neighbourhood is shown once you accept a contact. You set the meeting point yourself in the chat, with a closed agreement.

errors.zoneRequiredInPerson: Offering in person needs a zone. Choose your neighbourhood or tick only “remote”.
errors.modalityRequired: Tick at least one way to take part.

privacy.lead: What each person sees and from when. Nothing moves up a level unless you decide it.

visibleToVisitors.title: My profile is visible without an account
visibleToVisitors.body: Anyone arriving from outside can read your presentation and your skills.

searchable.title: My listings appear in search engines
searchable.body: Affects Google and the like. Search inside Time Swap does not change.

privacy.matrixTitle: From when each piece of data is visible
privacy.matrixHint: The whole policy at a glance. Each item is changed in its own section; the pencil takes you there.
privacy.footnote: Name, modality and district: always public. Email, phone, exact address and hour balance: never, at any moment.

memberProfile.contactNotice: Contact details are shared in the chat, once this person accepts your request.
memberProfile.ownProfileTitle: This is how people see you
memberProfile.ownProfileBody: This is your public profile as a member with an account sees it.
memberProfile.notFound: We could not find this profile.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not build this page. Try again in a moment.

footer.tagline: Time Swap · a neighbourhood time bank
